description: A crowd of citizens blocks your path. DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check to bypass, otherwise difficult terrain.
A large cart of tomatoes blocks your way. DC 12 Dexterity (Acrobatics) to vault, or fall and suffer disadvantage on next check.
The ground is slick with rancid sewer grease. DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or slide 15ft back and fall prone.
An aggressive guard dog barks and snaps at you. Make a DC 13 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check or take 1d4 piercing damage.
Low hanging laundry lines. DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of your turn.
A sudden dead end or detour. DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation) to find a side path instantly, or lose 10ft of movement.
Slippery wet cobblestones. DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.
An open manhole or grating. DC 12 Strength (Athletics) to leap over, or fall 10 feet down (1d6 damage).
Thick smoke from a nearby forge. DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned (choking) for 1 round.
A citizen drops a basket of marbles. DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or slide and fall prone.
A local merchant screams and drops a crate of glass bottles. DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or suffer 1d6 slashing damage.
Narrow scaffolding. DC 11 Dexterity (Acrobatics) to cross, or fall 10 feet and take 1d6 bludgeoning.
A low-flying flock of pigeons blinds you. DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or lose your direction.
Unstable roof tiles. DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or slide off, hanging by your fingertips.
A sudden burst of steam. DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 fire damage.
A beggar grabs your leg pleading for coin. DC 10 Strength check to shake off, or speed halved.
A rogue gust of wind blows sand in your eyes. DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until next turn.
A loose board or stone. DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or trip, spending 10ft of movement.
Narrow alleyway. Large creatures cannot pass without squeezing; others must succeed DC 10 Dexterity check.
Clear path! You gain an additional 10ft of movement this round.
